## Context

A live negative dogfood probe on Gerrit revision 8ac3d3c produced a built-in advisory but no project reviewer identity. Initial evidence showed the project prompt hash in the dependency snapshot, so repository asset capture occurred, but it did not prove that the project finder emitted a finding.

## Proven cause

Runtime experiments found that prompt metadata was read from the selected repository root while the prompt body was re-resolved without that root, producing an empty project-only prompt. Code review also computed an attested snapshot root and then discarded it for project-criterion discovery and validation. Direct ticket review and spec scan contained the same metadata/body split.

The historical revision is a limited canary: after the root repair it executes the full gate, but the unchanged project finder abstains in 5/5 isolated runs. Therefore it cannot produce project attribution. A strict FIRE fixture through the same production four-pass workflow proves that when the project finder emits, the finding retains its physical reviewer id, logical criterion id, and repository posture through Pass 3.

## Repair

- Resolve prompt metadata and bodies from one effective root.
- Use the attested snapshot for project-criterion discovery, validation, and execution; align explicit local runs to their live root.
- Apply the same repair to direct ticket review and spec scan.
- Preserve built-in and overlay-absent behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The precise changeable cause of the missing project reviewer and logical criterion identity is proven with runtime evidence from the real pipeline.
- [x] Automated coverage reproduces the root split before the fix and passes after it.
- [x] A project finding retains reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria project.review-phase-boundaries through clustering, Pass 2, Pass 3, and result emission.
- [x] Pass 3 applies block_threshold 0.90 and blocking_enabled false to the project finding, while overlay-absent and built-in attribution remain unchanged.
- [x] The repair lands through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments.
- [x] The unchanged historical probe is rerun and its limitation is quantified; a strict project FIRE fixture through the same full gate demonstrates the required identity and posture.
